name: TL082
description: Dual high-input-impedance operational amplifier with JFET inputs, giving very low input bias and offset currents. Offers high slew rate, low input offset, and internal frequency compensation. Well suited to high-impedance sources, filters, and audio where the bipolar NE5532/4558 family loads the source too heavily.

pins.name: VCC-
pins.description: Negative supply rail (or GND in single-supply use)

extra.Vos: 3mV typ (10mV max) @ Ta=25C, TL082C grade (13mV max full range)
extra.Ibias: 65pA typ (200pA max) @ Ta=25C, TL082C grade (7nA max full range)

typical_application: High-impedance buffers, active filters, integrators, and instrument/guitar input stages.
gotchas: JFET inputs give very high input impedance and tiny bias current, ideal for high-Z sources where the bipolar NE5532 would load the source
can latch up or behave abnormally if an input is driven beyond the supply rails; clamp or keep inputs within VCC- to VCC+
pin 4 is VCC- (negative rail), not ground, in split-supply designs
decouple both supply rails near the device to prevent oscillation
